Are you an experienced WTG Storekeeper / Logistics Coordinator?

…then take a closer look at GWS!!!

Global Wind Service is a leading supplier of manpower for wind turbine installation and servicing, with offices located in 10 countries and almost 1,000 technicians working across the globe.

Our business is dynamic, fast-paced, flexible and adaptable to our clients’ needs in order to deliver excellent service and results.

FOCUS ON PEOPLE

At GWS our employees play an integral role in our vision for the future and in achieving our goal to be the preferred partner for complete wind turbine services.

GWS has a strong team culture and we are always looking for smart, hard-working people who strive for excellence in their work and appreciate collaboration.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are ramping up and expanding our team of experienced Storekeepers / Logistics Coordinators across platforms for site-based activities On and Offshore, to provide safe services of high quality and to continue to exceed our customers’ expectations.

You will have an active, hands on part to play in the smooth operation of the site.

TYPICAL DUTIES WILL INCLUDE

• 
Providing Technicians with tooling daily

• 
Manual handling including, receiving deliveries, and unloading tooling and equipment

• 
Transportation of tooling and equipment on site

• 
Registration, monitoring and tracking of tooling/equipment in site systems

• 
Ordering replacement tooling

• 
Processing and returning damaged/no longer required equipment to head office warehouse

• 
Forklift and telehandler associated tasks

• 
Stocktaking / Inventory

• 
Supporting Site Manager and team during project

• 
Responsibility and accountability for Health and Safety in your team

• 
Accurate and timely completion of relevant paperwork during works

• 
Ambassador for the GWS and its culture and values

Sound like you? To apply you need to be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, dynamic, high performing and international work environment in the renewable energy sector.

We highly value initiative, responsibility

and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions.

• 
A workplace that focuses on safety.

• 
An opportunity to work with a leading supplier of manpower in wind industry.

• 
The opportunity to further develop your skills and professional development.

• 
Competitive remuneration.

• 
Global career progression prospects.

• 
High-quality Safety Equipment (PPE) and working clothes.

• 
Paid training.

• 
Paid travel and accommodation during rotation.

• 
Meal Allowance / per diem allowance during rotation.

• 
Beside the job itself, you’ll be looked after.

• 
Your happiness and your well-being are a priority.

For GWS it is important to prepare & safeguard our technicians, so they are properly equipped to do the job correctly and safely.

We want our employees to succeed! Joining GWS will embark you on a great journey with career development in a global organisation.

SAME CHANCE FOR EVERYONE:

GWS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex,

sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, and according with all local laws protecting different status.

Are you ready to show your full potential in the wind industry?

Do you want to work in a field where your impact matters?

We invite you to apply now by clicking the “Apply for this job” tab to submit your application!

Please include your resume outlining your relevant and previous work history, along with any licences and qualifications applicable to the role.

We are looking forward to your application and wish you lots of success!

REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

• 
Experience of working as a Storekeeper / Logistics Coordinator onsite for WTG projects, ideally 1+ years

• 
Experience in manufacturer systems e.g. ERP (Oracle etc.), WMS, SAP

• 
Experience in AX system

• 
GWO Trainings, OGUK, Chester Step

• 
Offshore Trainings (desirable)

• 
GWO BTT (desirable)

• 
Telehandler / Forklift training (desirable)

• 
Slinger Banksman (desirable)

• 
Safety Passport e.g. CCNSG (desirable)

• 
Strong understanding of logistical and warehousing processes

• 
Efficient

• 
Proactive

• 
Team Player

• 
Problem Solver

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive Business-Led Innovation: Identify and assess high-potential business challenges and market opportunities, building business cases and revenue models.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

• Act as the Core Connector: Bridge leadership, business stakeholders, R&D, domain experts, and engineering teams to align goals and direction.

• Accelerate Delivery: Drive progress from exploration and validation to implementation, delivering measurable results in weeks to months.

• Frame & Structure Concepts: Turn complex ideas into clear opportunities, hypotheses, trade-offs, and actionable next steps.

• Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with leadership on executive communication, representing the team with confidence and transparency.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong Commercial Mindset: Assess market potential, customer value, and ROI while balancing commercial and technical perspectives.

• Product & Portfolio Experience: Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner, or Portfolio Manager leading digital solutions from discovery to delivery.

• Domain & Digital Familiarity: Experience or strong interest in digital services, IoT, cloud solutions, connected products, and industrial applications.

• Exceptional Structuring Skills: Bring clarity, focus, and direction to complex and ambiguous challenges.

• Proactive Communicator: Excel at stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and team representation.

• Outcome-Driven Execution: Deliver measurable business results by driving progress, prioritizing effectively, and managing trade-offs.

• Education & Language: Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar, with fluent professional English.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**About Us

**Do you wish to join the House of Dreams?

In this House, you will continue to perpetuate the dream of our creator: that of a more beautiful and happier world.

You will also consolidate our vision: to become the most desirable House in the world of beauty, an absolute reference of French luxury, a symbol of joy and hope.

This Vision Is Carried By Our Six Values That You Will Embody Daily As Designers Of Dreams - Values That Engage And Define Us

_Create Passionately

__Craft together with joy

__Excel for ultimate luxury

__Lead with audacity

__Cultivate Triumphant inclusivity

__Commit and act to re-enchant the world.

__**Design your dreams with Dior.

**_**Your Impact

**As Training Manager, you have the pivotal mission to embody and champion the exquisite heritage and brand values of DIOR while driving the development of human capital (Beauty Consultants, Promoters, Generic Staff) and retail excellence across PCD's doors within a dynamic travel retail environment.

Fostering a culture of continuous learning and outstanding client experience, you inspire and equip retail teams with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to deliver on both collective and individual performance objectives. A true learning strategist, you design and deploy multi-faceted training programs and action plans that empower teams to over-achieve their POS objectives while nurturing strong performers and future people developers.

You play an essential role as the key link between the field (70% of your time) and HQ stakeholders, translating business priorities into impactful learning solutions across the following three key areas: Beauty Consultants coaching, In-class and digital trainings and Seminars.

Position

**BEAUTY CONSULTANTS COACHING

**

• Design and deploy a structured and progressive training curriculum covering product knowledge, brand heritage, makeup artistry, skincare expertise and advanced selling techniques, together with the Retail Manager in your region

• Track and measure knowledge acquisition through regular quizzes, certifications and practical assessments,

• Conduct individual appraisals at regular intervals, delivering clear, constructive and motivating feedback to each Beauty Consultant

• Build and monitor personalized Individual Development Plans for each Beauty Consultant, setting SMART objectives and milestones to track progress over time

• Oversee BC uniform and grooming allocation to ensure every BC is impeccably equipped at all times

**IN CLASS AND DIGITAL TRAININGS

**

• Conduct tailor-made and context specific trainings based on the knowledge and analysis of each point of sale (airport typology, passenger profile, product assortment)

• Lead the operational preparation of the training sessions by defining the timing, the place, the attendees and all logistics aspects aligned with the Retail Manager and key commercial milestones (product launches, peak travel periods, trade animation)

• Measure the efficiency and business impact of every training through a clear set of KPIs and using sell out data

• Develop and upskill promoters and generic staff populations in key strategic airports by designing targeted and time-efficient training programs

**SEMINARS

**

• At Travel Retail Europe level: support the organization, coordination and animation of the Annual Convention with all Dior Beauty Consultants in collaboration with the Travel Retail Training Department

• At your perimeter level: organize with the Retail Manager and animate the Local Seminars (Sales Cycle) 3 times a year in physical or/and digital

• Maintain a rigorous budget tracking process to ensure cost efficiency and return on investment aligned with business priorities

**REPORTING TO

**

• Area Manager (based in Paris)

• The responsibilities outlined in this job description are subject to change based on the company's needs and ongoing projects

Profile

Ideally, you would have 3 years of experience in Retail Training, Coaching and Retail Management

**Create Passionately

**Soft skills that align with our values:

• Creative & Innovative

**Lead With Audacity

**

• Exemplary Leadership & People Management Capacity

• Stakeholder Management Capacity

**Craft Together With Joy

**

• Teamwork & Collaboration

**Cultivate Triumphant Inclusivity

**

• Learning Agility

**Excel For Ultimate Luxury

**

• Attention to detail

**Other Skills

**

• Master Diplloma from an International Business school

• Knowledge of perfumes and cosmetics preferable.

• Curiosity about travel retail business

• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in additional languages relevant to the travel retail location is a significant advantage

• Flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as dictated by the demands of a dynamic travel retail environment

• It is expected to be on the field and traveling at a minimum of 4 days per week.

Additional information

Inclusivity is not just a noble principle; it is the very heart of our excellence. In a world where our clients, talents, and ideas increasingly come from diverse backgrounds, our diversity is our strength.

At Parfums Christian Dior, this means being a House where everyone feels respected, welcomed, and valued, regardless of their uniqueness. Because we know well: a House that reflects this diversity is a sustainable, vibrant House, rooted in both dreams and reality. Inclusivity cannot be decreed; it is practiced daily.

(If you require any reasonable adjustments within the application process, feel free to indicate it in your application).

Additional information for internal candidate

Êtes-vous un employé d’LVMH ? Merci de candidater sur : WORK @LVMH – Voices

Recruitment steps

• Submit your application via our website. A recruiter will review your application. If your profile aligns with the requirements defined by our Hiring Team, you will be contacted for an initial HR interview. Subsequently, you will have interviews with the Hiring Manager, the Team Leader.

• The process outlined above is subject to change based on the company's evolving business needs.

Skills development opportunities

• Soft and Hard Skills you will develop in this role.

• Project management skills

• Understand the travel Retail Business

• Organization skills and ability to maintain a budget

• Potential Career Path from this role

• Senior Training Manager

At PriceShape, we are looking for a VP New Sales to take ownership of New ARR across Europe and globally. You will be responsible for defining the sales strategy, building and leading a high-performing sales organisation, and creating a scalable operating model that delivers predictable growth.

This is a senior commercial leadership role combining revenue ownership, strategic leadership, organisational design, and commercial execution. You will lead our Head of Sales and Head of Outreach and, through your leadership team, be responsible for building scalable teams that consistently generate qualified pipeline, convert opportunities into customers, and establish PriceShape’s position as the market leader.

You will report to the CRO and work closely with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and the executive leadership team.

The role can be based in either our headquarters in Aarhus, Denmark, or our office in Stockholm, Sweden. As the Sales organisation is spread across both locations, the role requires a fair amount of presence and travel between the two offices to ensure close collaboration with the team and strong alignment across markets.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Ownership & Growth Strategy

• 
Own and deliver the company's New ARR targets

• 
Translate company growth objectives into regional strategies, sales targets, and organisational plans

• 
Ensure predictable pipeline generation, conversion, and forecasting

• 
Drive commercial initiatives that unlock new revenue opportunities

• 
Monitor business performance through leading indicators, including pipeline coverage, win rates, deal velocity, and forecast accuracy

Sales Leadership & Organisational Scaling

• 
Lead, Coach and develop the Head of Sales and Head of Outreach to drive strong performance, develop their teams, and deliver against the overall sales strategy

• 
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, execution, and continuous improvement

• 
Design and scale the sales organisation to support ambitious growth across European markets

• 
Ensure consistent leadership practices, performance management, and coaching across teams

• 
Raise the leadership bar through succession planning, talent development, and organisational capability building

Outreach & Pipeline Generation

• 
Own the outbound pipeline generation strategy across Europe

• 
Ensure the outreach organisation consistently delivers high activity levels and qualified meetings with the right Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)

• 
Define activity standards, productivity targets, and quality expectations

• 
Drive continuous optimisation of outbound messaging, targeting, sequencing, and conversion rates in partnership with Marketing and Revenue Operations

• 
Ensure seamless collaboration between Outreach and Sales to maximise meeting conversion and pipeline creation

Go-to-Market Execution

• 
Define and continuously improve a scalable and repeatable sales operating model

• 
Drive consistent execution of qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM discipline

• 
Partner closely with Revenue Operations to optimise processes, reporting, and sales productivity

• 
Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve positioning, messaging, and commercial execution

• 
Ensure effective collaboration and handoff between Sales and Customer Success to maximise long-term customer value

Customer Quality & Market Leadership

• 
Ensure teams consistently acquire high-quality customers that fit our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)

• 
Maintain strong qualification standards across all regions and sales teams

• 
Partner with Product and Marketing to evolve ICPs, market segmentation, and commercial strategy

• 
Balance growth with customer quality to drive long-term retention and sustainable revenue

Hiring & Leadership Development

• 
Own the hiring and development of Heads of Sales and other senior commercial leaders

• 
Build the organisational structure needed to support continued European expansion

• 
Make decisive performance management decisions where necessary

• 
Ensure scalable onboarding, leadership development, and career progression across the sales organisation in partnership with Revenue Operations and P&C

What Success Looks Like

You will be accountable for the commercial performance and organisational development of the New Sales function. Key measures of success include:

• 
New ARR achieved vs. target

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy

• 
Qualified meetings booked

• 
Outbound activity levels

• 
Win rate

• 
Average deal size and sales cycle length

• 
Customer quality and retention of new customers

• 
Time-to-productivity for new hires

• 
Sales productivity across regions

• 
Leadership bench strength and employee retention

Who You Are

You are an experienced B2B SaaS sales leader who has successfully scaled sales organisations across multiple markets. You combine strong commercial judgement with a structured and analytical approach, and you are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels.

You have experience leading leaders, building organisational capability, and creating the structures and operating rhythms needed to deliver predictable growth.

Skills and Experience

• 
10–15+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, including leadership of leaders

• 
A proven track record of scaling high-performing sales organisations across multiple markets

• 
Experience leading Heads of Sales or equivalent senior sales leaders

• 
Strong experience driving predictable New ARR growth in a fast-scaling SaaS environment

• 
Experience selling to both SMB and Enterprise customers

• 
Experience within e-commerce and brands

• 
Demonstrated success building scalable sales processes, forecasting, and operating rhythms

• 
Strong commercial judgement with a deep understanding of ICP, segmentation, and revenue strategy

• 
Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills

• 
Experience building and scaling sales teams across Europe

• 
Comfortable operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments with significant organisational change

What We Offer

• 
A senior leadership role with significant ownership of PriceShape’s New Sales organisation and growth

• 
The opportunity to shape and scale our commercial organisation across European markets

• 
Close collaboration with the executive leadership team and key functions across the business

• 
A culture built on trust, ownership, and high performance

• 
Opportunities for continued professional and leadership development

• 
Modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm

About PriceShape

PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands increase revenue and profitability through dynamic pricing and competitor tracking.

We are more than 100 colleagues from 25+ nationalities and growing across markets. Today, we serve customers in 25+ countries and aim to become the global category leader.

We value work-life balance, trust, and both personal and professional growth. We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance, great facilities, and an in-house canteen.

How to Apply

If you are interested in taking ownership of New ARR and building the sales organisation behind PriceShape’s continued growth, we would like to hear from you.

Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

As an Entry-level Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Copenhagen, you will join a dynamic project team to address complex client challenges. Responsibilities include conducting research, analysing data, preparing presentations and workshops, and contributing to client-ready deliverables. The role offers flexibility to specialise early, opportunities for international travel, and a supportive, inclusive environment. Applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s is also accepted), fluency in Danish or another Nordic language, and strong analytical and problem-solving skills. The position encourages initiative, creativity, and collaboration, with opportunities for professional growth and development. Hybrid working is available, and candidates are expected to be in the office at least three days per week.

Are you passionate about international collaboration and eager to join a dynamic, growing business? Become a vital part of our fantastic team in the Hotline department in Aarhus! As a Hotline Engineer in our Customer Diagnostics Center, you'll receive comprehensive training to deliver exceptional support to our global customers.

Welcome to our Hotline-department

Join our Aarhus office and become part of a dedicated team of more than 20 experts with over 350 years of combined experience, providing round-the-clock support to our customers worldwide. During your first 2-3 years, you'll undergo extensive training to become an independent support specialist for our global customers. Expect around 40 days of travel per year, with more travel initially as part of your training. To ensure the relevant areas are covered you will be highly involved in planning the training.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Technical support for our international customers, including training and counselling

• Troubleshooting via remote support

• Help customers correct errors and/or implement updates on-site

• Contribute to the further development of performance monitoring and data analysis in order to prevent errors

• Take care of Hotline-case reporting

Broad technical understanding and willingness to learn

You have a background in electrical engineering, possibly combined with a marine engineering education or similar. Ideally, you have experience in troubleshooting and rectifying errors on complex systems. Most importantly is your possession of broad technical knowledge and willingness to learn. Knowledge of Siemens PLC, Allen Bradley, Windows OS, Linux and SQL Databases will be an advantage, but if you lack any of it, we will be happy to teach you.

Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. Proficiency in Danish is a plus.

You thrive in managing stakeholders and handling a varied, sometimes unpredictable day. Your high quality, attention to detail, thoroughness, and service-minded, independent approach define your work style.

As a Hotline Engineer at BEUMER Group, you'll have numerous opportunities to grow and explore various roles within our company, both nationally and internationally.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the job, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Global Hotline, Nicolaj Olsen at +45 28 94 35 04

Apply now via the link, as we are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packaging, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader in the engineering and manufacturing of high-tech intralogistic systems for global markets. Our employees differentiate themselves by their ability to provide innovative solutions to our customers that incorporate a high-level of industry knowledge and a strong commitment to consistently and continuously expand their skills and knowledge. We fully support these high standards through a supportive teamwork structure, a mutual respect, and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Do you thrive in the field, solving technical challenges and working on advanced marine systems across different locations?

On behalf of our client, MARPRO Group is looking for a skilled Field Service Mechanic to support the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of advanced marine systems in Denmark and internationally.

You will become part of a highly specialised organisation working with advanced maritime and electronic systems in a demanding operational environment. The team combines technical expertise, innovation and a strong sense of purpose to deliver reliable solutions where quality, precision and commitment are essential.

The job

As a Field Service Mechanic, you will work with the installation, commissioning, service and maintenance of advanced marine equipment both in the workshop and at customer locations. A significant part of the role involves troubleshooting and repairing diesel engines, mechanical systems and hydraulic equipment to ensure reliable operation in demanding environments.

You will be responsible for diagnosing faults, carrying out repairs and overhauls, and supporting sea trials and commissioning activities. Working closely with engineers and technicians you will play an important role in resolving technical issues and ensuring that equipment performs according to specification.

The position combines workshop-based work with field assignments in Denmark and internationally and includes travel for up to 60 days per year.

People don't show up just to do a job. They show up because they have passion. We are looking for individuals with fire in their eyes and the right attitude.

Professional Qualifications

• You are educated as a Mechanic, Boat Mechanic, Ship Fitter, Diesel Mechanic, Truck Mechanic or have similar technical background

• Solid experience working with diesel engines such as Deutz, Cummins, MAN, MTU, Caterpillar, or similar, including fuel, cooling, and auxiliary systems

• Experience installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing mechanical, hydraulic, and rotating equipment

• Experience using PC-based diagnostic and engine management tools to identify faults and optimise equipment performance

• Troubleshooting

• Valid driving license

• Willingness to travel up to 60 days per year

• Fluency in English, eligibility to work within the EU, and ability to obtain EU security clearance

Personal characteristics

• Hands-on and passionate about mechanical troubleshooting and field service work

• Able to work independently and make sound technical decisions on-site

• Proactive, solution-oriented, and driven by solving technical challenges

• Reliable, flexible, and committed to delivering high-quality workmanship

• Comfortable working in changing environments and travelling as part of the role

• Customer-focused with strong communication and collaboration skills

• Eager to continuously expand technical knowledge and competencies

Our Client offers

• A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

• The opportunity to work with cutting‑edge technology and innovative systems.

• A professional environment with room to grow, develop and influence workflows.

• A supportive, collaborative team culture focused on high technical standards.

• Employment is subject to security clearance, ensuring a stable and trusted work setting

Application

The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

We strongly encourage you to connect with MARPRO Group, to be considered for job openings that are not publicly listed. It is 100% free and confidential to join our talent pool and you can create your personal profile in few minutes.

We are your gateway to Maritime & Shipping talent. Whether you’re a maritime or logistics company seeking exceptional professionals or a skilled individual searching for the next career opportunity, we connect the right talent with the right employers. Our extensive network and industry-specific expertise ensure a seamless recruitment process, making us the preferred choice for Maritime & Shipping staffing solutions.

We have the full and exclusive mandate to all positions listed and all applications have to go via MARPRO Group.

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Audio System Development

• 
Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• 
Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• 
Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

Signal Processing & Simulation

• 
Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• 
Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

System Performance & Collaboration

• 
Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• 
Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

• 
You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• 
You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• 
You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• 
It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• 
You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• 
You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• 
You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.

Statera is a Danish software company building a web-native platform for authoring, tagging and filing financial reports. We help accountants and businesses go from bookkeeping data to finished, compliant annual reports, including iXBRL/XBRL filing, in one modern tool.

We're looking for a newly graduated developer who wants to build a product from the inside, write code that ships to production every week, and grow into real ownership of a SaaS platform used by paying customers.

What you'll work on

You'll join our small product team and work across the whole Statera platform:

• Frontend in SvelteKit, TypeScript and Tailwind

• Backend in Python with FastAPI and Polars

• Integrations with accounting systems such as e-conomic and Dinero

• Report generation, financial calculations and iXBRL/XBRL output

• AI-powered features that help users write and review their reports

You'll work closely with the founders, start on concrete tasks from our backlog, and quickly move on to owning whole features and areas of the product, from idea and design to deploy and follow-up with customers.

Example tasks

• Designing and building new features across frontend and backend

• Building and maintaining APIs and third-party integrations

• Implementing financial calculations and data processing in Python

• Working on iXBRL/XBRL generation and validation

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

An internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security will give you the opportunity to gain insight into the work of identifying, preventing, and addressing security threats and risks that affect the activities, employees, and reputation of private corporations.

At the same time, the internship will allow you to test your skills in an environment of researchers, analysts, and advisors with experience from, among other places, national intelligence and security services.

As an intern at CERTA, you will be an integral part of the team you are assigned to and will be given a supervisor. The specific tasks you will be responsible for will vary depending on the team you join.

CERTA offers ongoing internships in each of the following areas:

• Intelligence collection and analysis

• Security consulting

Duration and Application Deadlines

We are looking for interns twice a year, and the internship lasts for six months:

• Spring (February 1st – July 31st)

• Application period is October 15th to November 15th the previous year

• Autumn (August 1st – January 31st)

• Application period is April 15th to May 15th

Requirements

You must be a student enrolled in a higher education institution at the bachelor’s or master’s level. Your application should specify whether the internship can be credited toward your degree and if you will receive student grants (SU) during the internship.

It is not a requirement that you are a Danish citizen or that you speak and write Danish fluently, although it may be beneficial if you understand Danish to some extent.

Qualifications

We are looking for students with strong analytical skills and methodological abilities, dedication, as well as a curious, open, and positive approach to problem-solving. Please include good examples of these qualifications in your application. Additionally, we expect you to have good English skills and preferably knowledge of other languages, as well as being IT proficient, including familiarity with the MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, and Word).

The internship should contribute to your education and will take place under the guidance of an academic staff member at CERTA Intelligence & Security. We recommend that you check in advance what academic requirements your educational institution has regarding an internship.

Vacation and Working Hours

The average working hours are 37 hours per week (excluding lunch break). You will accrue 2.08 vacation days for each month of your internship, totalling 12.5 days during your 6-month internship. If your study program requires you to write a major academic assignment in connection with your internship, you may also receive writing leave of up to 10 days, depending on the scope and complexity of the assignment.

Application

You can apply for an internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security by submitting a written and motivated application to internship@certaintelligence.com during the application period. When applying for an intern position, you must include your CV along with your diploma/grades. You may also choose to attach other relevant documents, such as references from employers or educational institutions.

Your motivated application should be written in English and not exceed one page, and it should include a description of why you want an internship, what you hope to gain from the internship, and what relevant experience and skills you have for the specific intern position.

It should be clearly stated in your application which area (“Intelligence collection and analysis” or “Security consulting”) you are applying for an intern position.

You may be invited to an interview regarding your application, and no later than two months before the start of the internship (December 1st or June 1st), you will receive a response about whether we can offer you an internship position.
